summary.narrow: Sagada — характерная точка региона, полезная для понимания местной среды, повседневности и культурного контекста.

sections.text: Sagada — характерная точка региона, полезная для понимания местной среды, повседневности и культурного контекста.

entry.access_status: registration required; guided access for regulated activities

fee.description: Registration, environmental/tour fees and guide fees depend on selected activity; book/acquire through Sagada Tourism and accredited partners.

hours.value: Sagada town itself has no single gate schedule. Tourist registration is required; caves, waterfalls and trekking routes have route-specific guide/schedule rules.

entry.closure_notes: Road/route closures may follow heavy rain, landslides or local cultural restrictions.
entry.notes: Mountain road approach; Sagada Tourism Office explicitly advises daylight driving due fog, narrow winding roads and steep grades.

legs.notes: Mountain road approach; Sagada Tourism Office explicitly advises daylight driving due fog, narrow winding roads and steep grades. В городах — местный общественный транспорт/ride-hailing; в удалённых районах чаще практичнее частный трансфер, арендованный транспорт или оператор. Visitors are required to register at the Tourism Office; caves/treks use accredited local guide organisations.

rules.permit_or_guide: Tourist registration mandatory; use accredited guide organizations for regulated routes/caves.
rules.access_requirements: Проверить ступени, грунт, лодочные посадки и доступность на официальной странице; природные и археологические объекты часто не безбарьерны.

seasonality.best_period: Drier months are operationally easier; official tourism office flags June–October rainy season for landslide risk.
seasonality.heat_rain_notes: Highland town ~1,500 m: cooler than lowlands; fog can sharply reduce road visibility.
seasonality.site_specific_notes: Mountain road, steep terrain, landslide risk in rainy season.

restrictions: Проверять национальные авиационные правила и отдельное разрешение владельца/парка; в охраняемых, религиозных, археологических и приграничных зонах не запускать без явного допуска.

visual_recon.filming_restrictions: Respect burial/cultural sites and local guide rules; do not treat hanging coffins/caves as unrestricted sets.
